+def validate_reviewed_source(document: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Fail closed on the P6-02 evidence, ordering, and reuse invariants."""
+
+    parts = {
+        item["question_part_id"]: item for item in document["question_parts"]
+    }
+    approved_ids = {
+        part_id for part_id, item in parts.items() if item["status"] == "approved"
+    }
+    for item in parts.values():
+        if item["status"] == "approved" and (
+            not item["direct_qp_visual_review"]
+            or not item["direct_ms_visual_review"]
+            or not item["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            or not item["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("approved P6-02 part lacks exact QP/MS evidence")
+        if item["status"] == "candidate" and "procedure_model_ref" in item:
+            raise ValueError("P6-02 candidate exposed as approved")
+        if (
+            item["status"] == "approved"
+            and item["question_part_id"].endswith("/$whole")
+            and "whole_question_rollup_justification" not in item
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unjustified P6-02 whole-question rollup")
+
+    chains: dict[tuple[str, str], list[Mapping[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for instance in document["procedure_instances"]:
+        if (
+            instance["status"] != "approved"
+            or instance["question_part_id"] not in approved_ids
+            or not instance["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            or not instance["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("orphaned or unevidenced P6-02 ProcedureInstance")
+        key = (instance["question_part_id"], instance["branch_key"])
+        chains.setdefault(key, []).append(instance)
+        ref = instance["procedure_model_ref"]
+        if "reused_procedure_model_authority" in instance:
+            if "procedure_model" in instance:
+                raise ValueError("reused ProcedureModel was cloned")
+        elif ref.startswith("9709.p5.pm.") or ref == (
+            P601_POISSON_MOMENTS_MODEL_REF
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("cross-release ProcedureModel lacks reuse custody")
+
+    for chain in chains.values():
+        indexes = sorted(item["sequence_index"] for item in chain)
+        if indexes != list(range(1, len(indexes) + 1)):
+            raise ValueError("non-contiguous P6-02 branch sequence")
+    if any(value != 0 for value in document["hard_gates"].values()):

+        target.write_bytes(canonical_bytes(document, policy))
+
+
+def build_readback(cache_counters: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    ledger = _load(REVIEWED_SOURCE)
+    projection = _load(PROJECTION)
+    manifest = _load(MANIFEST)
+    chains: dict[str, int] = Counter(
+        item["question_part_id"] for item in ledger["procedure_instances"]
+    )
+    artifacts = []
+    for path in (
+        PREDECESSOR_RECEIPT,
+        REVIEWED_SOURCE,
+        DELTA,
+        PROJECTION,
+        MANIFEST,
+    ):
+        receipt = _receipt(path)
+        artifacts.append(
+            {
+                "byte_length": receipt.byte_length,
+                "path": path,
+                "sha256": receipt.sha256,
+            }
+        )
+    cumulative_status_counts = {
+        status: {
+            record_type: len(items)
+            for record_type, items in projection["status_boundaries"][status].items()
+        }
+        for status in ("abstain", "approved", "candidate", "rejected")
+    }
+    return {
+        "alternative_ms_route_count": len(ledger["alternative_ms_routes"]),
+        "artifact_bytes": artifacts,
+        "cache_and_raw_authentication": dict(cache_counters),
+        "cumulative_terminal_status_counts": cumulative_status_counts,
+        "denominator": {
+            "question_parts": 920,
+            "questions": 286,
+            "status": "PASS",
+        },
+        "deterministic_rebuild": "PASS",
+        "family": FAMILY,
+        "family_status_counts": ledger["status_counts"],
+        "hard_gates": ledger["hard_gates"],
+        "manifest_release_version": manifest["release_version"],
+        "ordered_composite_chain_count": sum(
+            length > 1 for length in chains.values()
+        ),
+        "procedure_model_metrics": ledger["procedure_model_metrics"],
+        "procedure_model_reuse": ledger["procedure_model_reuse"],
+        "review_metrics": ledger["direct_review_metrics"],
+        "schema_version": "9709_p6_02_family_readback_v1",
+        "supporting_question_count": len(SUPPORTING_QUESTION_IDS),
+        "visual_artifact_metrics": ledger["artifact_metrics"],
+    }
+
+
+def build_and_materialize(
+    predecessor_active_root: Path | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    write_sources(predecessor_active_root)
+    config = make_config()
+    harness = FutureReleaseSuiteHarness()
+    first = harness.load_or_build(config)
+    second = harness.load_or_build(config)
+    if first is not second:
+        raise RuntimeError("authenticated future cache did not reuse P6-02 build")
+    receipts = materialize_future_release(config, first)
+    deterministic = build_future_release(config)
+    if dict(first.bytes_by_path) != dict(deterministic.bytes_by_path):
+        raise RuntimeError("deterministic P6-02 cumulative rebuild failed")
+    cache_counters = asdict(harness.counters)
+    readback_target = ROOT / READBACK
+    readback_target.write_bytes(
+        canonical_bytes(
+            build_readback(cache_counters),
+            CanonicalSerializationPolicy(),
+        )
+    )
